units.source_text: “世累羁身”，暗指有皇太子之牵累，不能随君一同出家。

en.t: The phrase "bound by worldly ties" implicitly refers to the encumbrance of the Crown Prince, meaning that she cannot renounce the world together with him.

units.source_text: 后面藤壶答诗“何时全断世间缘”，亦暗示一切都已看破，惟对皇太子不能断念。

en.t: Later, Fujitsubo's reply poem, "When shall I completely sever my ties to the world?" also suggests that she has seen through everything, yet cannot give up her attachment to the Crown Prince.
